title: Clinic order body
description: An order the Clinic issues for one agent (clinic.md CL-4 and CL-5, register row DK28; spec-delta S261): a checkup (scheduled, after a change, or on request), or, after a diagnosis, a re-exam or a refresher course at the Academy. Signed by the Clinic. At most one unexpired order of each kind per agent. A re-exam or refresher course cites the diagnosis it follows and names the skill. A checkup is due within 7 days of the order, a re-exam or a course within 30. The order is not a penalty: an agent that does not sit it is shown as unchecked, not punished. Chain: none (prev is null).
